note: Meanings are short paraphrases. 9 of the 10 Indian entries were checked on 1 Nov 2026 against the Delhi Traffic Police public sign guide (a government site); 'sharp_curve' has no exact match and stays unverified. The MVA 1988 Schedule shows signs as pictures and IRC:67 was not re-read, so 'verified' here means wording checked against that guide, not against the legal drawings. GTSDB group entries describe a German benchmark's categories (class-to-group mapping verified against the dataset ReadMe; example lists in their text are not). Hindi labels left null: no authoritative Hindi source was retrieved.

signs.meaning: The driver has to stop (halt) at this point.
signs.guidance: Stop fully, check for traffic and pedestrians, proceed only when safe.
signs.source: Delhi Traffic Police, 'Learn Road Signages and Markings' (traffic.delhipolice.gov.in/en/node/108), read 1 Nov 2026. Wording checked against that guide only; legal sign forms are in the MVA 1988 Schedule (pictorial) and IRC:67, which were not re-read.

signs.meaning: A curve or bend is ahead. The official guide lists separate signs for right/left hand curves, hair-pin bends (sharp turns) and reverse bends; this generic entry has no exact official name.
signs.source: Delhi Traffic Police sign guide (cautionary signs) lists related signs; exact IRC:67 name not confirmed

signs.meaning: Belongs to the GTSDB 'prohibitory' group (for example speed limits and overtaking restrictions). This model detects the group, not the exact sign. It was trained on German GTSDB signs, not Indian signs.
signs.guidance: Read the sign itself to know the exact restriction.

signs.meaning: Belongs to the GTSDB 'danger' group (warning signs such as curves, crossings, slippery road). This model detects the group, not the exact sign. It was trained on German GTSDB signs, not Indian signs.
signs.guidance: Slow down and read the sign for the specific hazard.

signs.meaning: Belongs to the GTSDB 'mandatory' group (signs that prescribe a direction or action). This model detects the group, not the exact sign. It was trained on German GTSDB signs, not Indian signs.
signs.guidance: Read the sign for the required action.

signs.meaning: Belongs to the GTSDB 'other' group (for example stop, give way, priority road, no entry). This model detects the group, not the exact sign. It was trained on German GTSDB signs, not Indian signs.
signs.guidance: Read the sign itself; this group mixes very different meanings.
